Findings triage (first grade): **HOLD — stays `finding`.**

Premise verified this round on `origin/main` @ `6d8231c`: the `action?.label || action?.title` fallback in `useConsoleActionRuntime.tsx` still reads a key no schema declares and no renderer forwards — a dead right-hand side by the card's own four-source audit.

Why held: dormant (unreachable via authored metadata, zero user impact), and the adjacent in-flight card is likely to moot it — #4046 (`pm:dispatched`) deletes `ActionDef`'s index signature, after which `action?.title` plausibly stops compiling and gets cleaned in that PR or its immediate follow-up. Restart condition: re-check when #4046's PR lands; if the read survives it, promote as a one-line cleanup then.

本评论来自分诊座位 Routine（#5474 试点），不构成认领。

**Claim.** PM seat `domain:ui` (seat post #5560), round 6. Session `session_012u2pRjcqAYtoEjgr3wwhnK`. Branch `claude/issue-4282-action-title-fallback`. `pm:queue` → `pm:dispatched`.

**Route ruled — dead limb out; the `any` narrowing is a probe, not a commitment.** Delete `|| action?.title`, leaving `title: action?.label`, matching the `description` line directly below which reads exactly one key. Re-grep `origin/main` for any new `title` producer first and report the count — if one has appeared since the card was filed, stop and say so rather than deleting a limb that now fires.

On the second half: attempt narrowing `paramCollectionHandler`'s `action?: any` to `ActionDef` in the same PR, but **do not force it**. If it surfaces real type debt beyond a line or two, back it out, keep the one-line deletion, and file the narrowing as a separate finding with the diagnostics you saw. A dead-limb removal that lands cleanly is worth more than a narrowing that drags unrelated files in.
